009974** A2K-ACCEPT-TODAYS-DATE.                                     ** 000700      
009975** This Paragraph accepts the TODAYS-DATE from System in Long  ** 000800      
009976** Format e.g. MM/DD/CCAA. And it converts into a numeric      ** 000900      
009977** date MMDDCCAA, which is returned into the variable          ** 001000

009982        MOVE ZEROES TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-001.                          001500      
009983*       MOVE "    " TO A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA.                          001600      
009984        ACCEPT A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA FROM TODAYS-DATE.                 001700      
009985        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-MM TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-MM-001.          001800      
009986        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-DD TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-DD-001.          001900

009988        MOVE A2K-SYSTEM-FECHA-AA TO A2K-FEC-MDCA-AA-001.          002100
